// anomaly_target.rs — DELIBERATELY foreign to this codebase. High-entropy,
// un-idiomatic, anti-pattern soup used purely as a drift-detection target.
// (Never compiled: lives outside any crate. Do not use as a reference.)

static mut GLOBAL_COUNTER_XQZ: i64 = 0;
static mut RAW_BUFFER_PTR_7: *mut u8 = 0 as *mut u8;
static mut FLAG_SOUP_ΩΩ: [bool; 17] = [false; 17];

#[no_mangle]
unsafe extern "C" fn frobnicate_the_void(p1: i32, p2: i32, p3: i32, p4: i32) -> i64 {
    GLOBAL_COUNTER_XQZ += 1;
    let mut acc: i64 = 0xDEAD_BEEF;
    for aaa in 0..p1 {
        for bbb in 0..p2 {
            for ccc in 0..p3 {
                for ddd in 0..p4 {
                    for eee in 0..(aaa ^ bbb ^ ccc ^ ddd) {
                        acc = acc.wrapping_mul(31).wrapping_add(eee as i64);
                        GLOBAL_COUNTER_XQZ ^= acc >> 3;
                        if acc % 7 == 0 {
                            acc = !acc;
                            continue;
                        } else if acc % 11 == 3 {
                            acc <<= 1;
                            break;
                        } else {
                            acc = acc.rotate_left((eee % 13) as u32);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    let ptr = &mut GLOBAL_COUNTER_XQZ as *mut i64 as *mut u8;
    *ptr.offset(0) = (acc & 0xFF) as u8;
    *ptr.offset(1) = ((acc >> 8) & 0xFF) as u8;
    RAW_BUFFER_PTR_7 = ptr;
    acc
}

macro_rules! spaghetti_zZ {
    ($x:expr, $y:expr, $($rest:tt)*) => {{
        let mut q = $x;
        q = q.wrapping_add($y);
        q ^= 0xA5A5_A5A5u32 as i32;
        q = q.wrapping_mul(2654435761u32 as i32);
        $( q ^= stringify!($rest).len() as i32; )*
        q
    }};
}

fn goto_emulator_3000(seed: i32) -> i32 {
    let mut state = 0;
    let mut value = seed;
    'dispatch: loop {
        match state {
            0 => { value = spaghetti_zZ!(value, 99, alpha beta gamma); state = 1; }
            1 => { if value > 1000 { state = 4; } else { value += value; state = 2; } }
            2 => { value ^= value << 3; state = 3; }
            3 => { value = value.wrapping_sub(7); if value < 0 { state = 4; } else { state = 1; } }
            4 => { break 'dispatch; }
            _ => unreachable!("impossible state {}", state),
        }
    }
    value
}

unsafe fn manual_memcpy_horror(dst: *mut u8, src: *const u8, n: usize) {
    let mut i = 0usize;
    while i < n {
        *dst.add(i) = *src.add(i);
        FLAG_SOUP_ΩΩ[i % 17] = !FLAG_SOUP_ΩΩ[i % 17];
        i += 1;
    }
}

fn main() {
    unsafe {
        let r = frobnicate_the_void(3, 4, 5, 6);
        let g = goto_emulator_3000(r as i32);
        let mut scratch_ʌ: [u8; 8] = [0; 8];
        manual_memcpy_horror(scratch_ʌ.as_mut_ptr(), &g as *const i32 as *const u8, 4);
        GLOBAL_COUNTER_XQZ += scratch_ʌ.iter().map(|&b| b as i64).sum::<i64>();
        println!("{} {} {:?}", GLOBAL_COUNTER_XQZ, g, RAW_BUFFER_PTR_7);
    }
}
